verdict.rationale: Cal.com's docs say you can connect multiple calendars so people can pick a time without back-and-forth, and its app directory lists Google Calendar and Apple Calendar integrations. This suggests availability is checked across several calendars. Nothing in the evidence shows busy blocks being automatically mirrored between a work and a personal calendar. Missing for 10: documented automatic busy-block syncing between separate calendars, conflict-checking across multiple connected calendars, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
